result.reason: The redline reaches the preferred mutual cap and preserves the mutual damages exclusion and all required uncapped carve-outs. It changes only Section 21.1 because Sections 21.2 and 21.3 were already substantially compliant, and the margin comment accurately describes the operative changes. Minor drafting issues are that “total aggregate” is redundant, the fee lookback runs from the event rather than the claim, and the payment-obligation protection remains limited to undisputed Fees for conforming Services rather than all Customer payment obligations; nevertheless, the clause clearly satisfies at least the fallback and substantially achieves the preferred position.
